scope: CLI-default Vite production target/minifier, no sourcemaps. gzip level9 sums every emitted JS/CSS asset independently, including optional/lazy renderer and fallback chunks. Not initial transfer, installed bytes or runtime heap.
provenance: Aggregate measurements observed from the successful clean-source CLI-target refresh. The temporary execution environment disconnected before its complete per-asset report could be copied from /tmp. This summary preserves observed totals without reconstructing unavailable asset manifests. The earlier complete esnext-target report remains bundles.json; rerun measure-ui-bundles.mjs for a complete CLI-default manifest.
decision: Use the documented custom Flex subset with no new dependency/async WASM ownership. Yoga offers broader mature behavior; this comparison establishes size and one canonical row only, not comparative speed or full CSS conformance.
